reference.wholeBattleContextReason: Reflect the real VM global object with ordinary Script var/function binding descriptors; contextified sandbox wrappers change configurability and hide uninitialized bindings from parent reflection.
reference.reason: Default JIT tiers and --no-opt produced different NaN bits for identical source and inputs. --jitless was stable across all six cold/warmed probe processes.
reference.throughputPolicy: Performance measurements may use compiled native candidates or separately identified runtime flags. Qualification compares candidate traces against this pinned source profile; measurements alone do not establish equivalence.
reference.scope: Reproducible reference implementation profile, not a claim that ECMAScript specifies NaN sign/payload or that all engine versions produce identical bits.

limitations: Diagnostic JS specialization prototype adds a wrapper and reflection overhead; timings do not estimate native clone throughput.
Repeated single scenario, callback-only host; full actor/effect frame lifecycle is outside adapter.
Terminal engine/device descriptor graphs and result/RNG/callback counts compare exactly; this tool does not compare per-event graphs or hidden closure state.

Eligibility is conservative: plain source-realm extensible objects with own default finite-number fields, no inherited key conflicts, original Object/keys/constructor. Unsupported inputs execute the original source function.
